en.name: Graham crackers and animal crackers
en.summary: Graham crackers and animal crackers keep 6–9 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. They are dry sweet biscuits, so they do not spoil in any microbial sense; they go soft and they go stale, and humidity is what does it.
en.pantry: 6–9 months from purchase, sealed, cool, dark and dry. There is so little water in a baked cracker that nothing can grow in it, so the clock is a flavour and texture clock: the fat in the biscuit slowly stales, and the biscuit itself pulls moisture out of the air until it bends instead of snapping. An inner sleeve that has been torn open is not a seal — clip it or tip the biscuits into an airtight tin, and keep the box away from the kettle and the hob.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published, and the fridge is the wrong place for these. A domestic fridge is humid, and a biscuit that has gone limp in the fridge has gained exactly the moisture you were trying to keep out of it. A sealed tin in a cool cupboard does the job better.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Freezing does no harm — a dry biscuit has almost no water to form ice crystals — but the cupboard figure is already long, so there is rarely a reason. If you do freeze a box, keep it in its sleeve inside a freezer bag and let the whole thing return to room temperature before opening it.
en.thawing: Nothing to thaw. Let any chilled or frozen pack warm up fully while still sealed, then open it.
spoilage: Biscuits that bend instead of snapping — moisture, not spoilage.
A stale, cardboard or crayon-like smell from the fat going off.
Mould or a musty smell in a box that got wet.
Weevils, moths or fine powdery dust in the sleeve.
tips: Decant an opened sleeve into an airtight tin; the cardboard box is not a barrier.
Store away from steam — the shelf above the kettle is the worst spot in the kitchen.
Five minutes in a low oven crisps up biscuits that have gone soft.
Write the opening date on the tin so the oldest box gets eaten first.

faq.q: How long do graham crackers keep?
faq.a: 6–9 months from purchase in a sealed pack in a cool, dry cupboard.
Not in the dangerous sense. They go soft and stale, and the fat in them eventually tastes of cardboard. Mould only appears if the box got damp.
You can, and the texture survives because there is almost no water in them, but no freezer timeline is published and the cupboard already gives you the better part of a year.

zh.name: 全麥消化餅與動物餅乾
zh.summary: 全麥消化餅與動物餅乾自購買日起，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6～9 個月。它們是乾的甜餅，談不上什麼微生物腐敗；它們是軟掉、走味，而元凶是濕氣。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 6～9 個月。烤過的餅乾含水量低到長不出東西，所以這個期限算的是風味和口感：餅乾裡的油脂會慢慢出現陳味，餅乾本身則不斷把空氣裡的水氣吸進來，吸到咬下去是彎的而不是「喀」的一聲。撕開的內袋不算密封——請夾緊，或整個倒進氣密鐵罐，盒子也別放在熱水壺和爐台附近。
zh.fridge: 沒有冷藏的期限數據，而且冰箱對這類餅乾來說是錯的地方。家用冰箱裡是潮濕的，冰過後變得軟趴趴的餅乾，等於正好吸進了你想擋掉的那些水氣。密封鐵罐放陰涼櫥櫃，效果更好。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。凍了不會壞——乾餅乾幾乎沒有水可以結成冰晶——但櫥櫃的期限本來就夠長，很少有理由這麼做。真要冷凍，請連內袋一起裝進冷凍袋，並且整包完全回溫後再打開。
zh.thawing: 沒有東西要解凍。冰過或凍過的餅乾，請維持密封完全回溫再開封。
spoilage: 餅乾會彎而不是清脆折斷——那是受潮，不是腐敗。
油脂走味後出現的陳味、紙板味或蠟筆味。
受潮的盒子長霉或有霉味。
內袋裡出現米蟲、穀蛾或細細的粉屑。
tips: 開封後倒進氣密鐵罐；紙盒本身擋不住水氣。
遠離蒸氣，熱水壺上方那一格是全廚房最糟的位置。
軟掉的餅乾放低溫烤箱烘五分鐘就會回脆。
在鐵罐上寫開封日期，先開先吃。

faq.q: 全麥消化餅可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 6～9 個月。
不太會壞到危險的程度。它會軟掉、走味，油脂最後會有紙板味。只有盒子受潮才會長霉。
可以，而且因為幾乎不含水，口感撐得住；但它沒有冷凍的期限數據，而櫥櫃本來就給了大半年。
